<!-- Generated by apps/docs/scripts/gen_reference.py from `python -m vstudio.<module> --help`. Do not edit here: edit the source and re-run. -->

The engine is a Python package (`vstudio`, in `lib/`). The Mac app and the Claude Code skill both call these commands; you can run them yourself from a terminal:

```bash
cd ~/.claude/skills/video-studio        # or your clone of the repository
export PYTHONPATH="$PWD/lib:$PYTHONPATH"
python3 -m vstudio.intake --help
```

Every command that reports something accepts `--json` for one machine-readable document. Each workflow also has its own scripts under `workflows/<name>/scripts`; see [Workflows](/docs/reference/workflows/talkinghead/).

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`vstudio.intake`](#vstudiointake) | Say what you want and point at files: inventory, plan, revise, apply. |
| [`vstudio.project`](#vstudioproject) | Every workflow as a recipe; projects, runs, checkpoints, inbox, outputs, calendar. |
| [`vstudio.batch`](#vstudiobatch) | Batch production: plan, estimate, run, status, review, package. |
| [`vstudio.cleanup`](#vstudiocleanup) | Shared speech cleanup: pauses, fillers, repeats, restarts. |
| [`vstudio.export`](#vstudioexport) | One clean master into a file, cover and post stub per platform. |
| [`vstudio.reframe`](#vstudioreframe) | Face-tracked reframe between aspect ratios. |
| [`vstudio.platform`](#vstudioplatform) | Print the platform profiles. |
| [`vstudio.effects`](#vstudioeffects) | List and inspect the effect registry. |
| [`vstudio.llm`](#vstudiollm) | AI providers on this machine: list, route, auth, test. |
| [`vstudio.retouch`](#vstudioretouch) | Portrait retouch and makeup for photos and frames. |

## `vstudio.intake`

Say what you want and point at files: inventory, plan, revise, apply.

```text
usage: python -m vstudio.intake [-h] {analyze,plan,revise,apply,schema} ...

python -m vstudio.intake analyze | plan | revise | apply | schema (every command: --json -> one
document).

positional arguments:
  {analyze,plan,revise,apply,schema}
    analyze             inventory files / folders (video, audio, images, pdf / docx / pptx / md /
                        srt)
    plan                natural-language request + materials -> plan JSON
    revise              update a plan from a follow-up instruction
    apply               create the project(s) from a plan (a series when mixed); pilot run
                        optional
    schema              the plan JSON Schema

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

## `vstudio.project`

Every workflow as a recipe; projects, runs, checkpoints, inbox, outputs, calendar.

```text
usage: python -m vstudio.project [-h]
                                 {recipes,new,plan-items,show,status,preview,context,refresh,run,resume,checkpoint,set,export,list,adopt,touch,output,ai,series,inbox,calendar}
                                 ...

python -m vstudio.project - every workflow as a recipe; projects of N items (N=1 = one video). See

positional arguments:
  {recipes,new,plan-items,show,status,preview,context,refresh,run,resume,checkpoint,set,export,list,adopt,touch,output,ai,series,inbox,calendar}
    recipes             list recipe manifests
    new                 create a project
    plan-items          planner recipes: draft the items (segments of a recording)
    show                manifest + project.yaml + status
    status              items and stages
    preview             preview artifacts
    context             agent hook: compact state + playbook + commands
    refresh             re-read project.yaml + item files, re-plan
    run                 run until done or a checkpoint
    resume              run until done or a checkpoint
    checkpoint          pending checkpoints / answer one
    set                 edit params
    export              collect final files
    list                registered projects (+ adopted work folders, series)
    adopt               an existing folder made with the skill -> work record + registry
    touch               register a job folder + report its live status (desk 进行中 lane)
    output              second-pass edit of a finished output (references/OUTPUT_EDIT.md)
    ai                  project-level AI edit of every output (grouped per output; needs_rerender)
    series              series presets
    inbox               pending checkpoints across projects
    calendar            publish calendar

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

python -m vstudio.project - every workflow as a recipe; projects of N items (N=1 = one video). See
references/PROJECTS.md.

  recipes [--json] [--schema]                         all recipe manifests + capabilities (--schema: the JSON Schema)
  new --recipe R --dir P [--name N] [--input key=path ...] [--folder D [--glob G]] [--list F] [--csv F]
      [--episodes N] [--param k=v ...] [--set JSON] [--series S] [--client C] [--variants JSON] [--auto a,b]
      [--spec JSON]                                   create a project (items from files / lines / rows / episodes)
  plan-items --dir P [--replace] [--provider X] [--count N] [--min S --max S]   planner recipes: draft the items
  show | status | preview [--item I] [--stage S] | context [--write] | refresh   --dir P [--json]
  run | resume --dir P [--pilot N] [--confirm-pilot] [--items a,b] [--auto ids|all] [--concurrency k=n]
      [--json | --json-events]                        run until done or a checkpoint needs you (exit 7)
  checkpoint --dir P [--id X] [--item I | --items a,b] [--answer JSON | --answer-file F | --default] [--run]
                                                      list pending payloads / record an answer
  set --dir P [--item I] (--param k=v ... | --set JSON)   edit params in project.yaml, then refresh
  export --dir P [--out D] [--all] [--items a,b]      final files + manifest.json (sha256)
  list                                                registered projects (lanes) with their state + adopted work
                                                      folders (kind work) + series
  adopt DIR [--recipe guess|NAME] [--title T] [--client C]   a plain folder made with the skill (final/, REPORT.md,
                                                      post.md, ...) -> DIR/.vstudio/work.json + registry (works.py)
  touch DIR [--status running|waiting|done|failed] [--stage S] [--progress 0..1] [--message M] [--eta S]
      [--needs-you] [--recipe R] [--title T] [--outputs a,b]   register a job folder + its live status (heartbeat)
  output list | show | edit | render | undo | redo | revert | ai | chat | effects  --project P --output O   2nd-pass edit of
      one finished output (references/OUTPUT_EDIT.md): edit --ops JSON | --op NAME --param k=v | --op ai
      --instruction T [--apply]; render [--quality preview|final] [--targets primary,douyin:vertical|all]
  ai --project P --instruction T [--outputs all|a,b] [--context JSON] [--timeout 120] [--json | --json-events]
                                                      project-level AI edit: one model call for every output ->
                                                      grouped changes per output, or needs_rerender (burned-in text
                                                      on flattened outputs; answered by rules, no model call)
  series new --id S --recipe R [--name N] [--set JSON] [--cadence JSON] | show --id S | list | update --id S --set JSON
  inbox [--json] | inbox answer (--project P --id X [--item I] | --id X / --kind K [--projects a,b]) (--answer JSON | --default)
  calendar account add --id A --platform P [--times 12:00,19:00] [--per-day N] [--days 0,1,2,3,4]
  calendar plan --project P [--accounts a,b] [--start ISO] | calendar set --post ID --state S [--at ISO] [--url U]
  calendar list [--start ISO] [--end ISO] [--account A] | calendar add --account A --at ISO [--title T]
--json: one JSON document on stdout; --json-events: one JSON event per line on stdout (logs -> stderr).
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed items, 2 refused (budget), 3 paused, 4 pilot waits, 5 bad input, 6 busy, 7 needs you.
```

## `vstudio.batch`

Batch production: plan, estimate, run, status, review, package.

```text
usage: python -m vstudio.batch [-h]
                               {plan,estimate,run,status,review,job,plan-segments,client,deliver,cleanup-sources,metrics,timing,package,verify-manifest,clean,du,bench,recipes}
                               ...

python -m vstudio.batch - batch video production (Fleet F0). See references/BATCH.md.

positional arguments:
  {plan,estimate,run,status,review,job,plan-segments,client,deliver,cleanup-sources,metrics,timing,package,verify-manifest,clean,du,bench,recipes}
    plan                spec -> jobs in the batch store
    estimate            time / storage / cost estimate and budget check
    run                 run the jobs
    status              job table
    review              HTML review page / apply decisions
    job                 one job: show (transcript, edits, captions, QC, exports) | edit | rerun
    plan-segments       transcript -> candidate segments (segments.draft.yaml)
    client              client workspace: init | show | update | list
    deliver             client delivery package (per-platform folders, 文案.md, 排期表, zip)
    cleanup-sources     list (dry run) / delete, with the dry run's code, source files of
                        deliveries past their cleanup date
    metrics             metrics: --batch / --client / --all, JSON or the weekly CSV
    timing              review timing event -> batch store
    package             publish folders + schedule + confirmation code
    verify-manifest     recompute a package confirmation code
    clean               delete regenerable intermediates
    du                  disk use
    bench               benchmark table
    recipes             list recipes

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

python -m vstudio.batch - batch video production (Fleet F0). See references/BATCH.md.

  plan SPEC [--batch DIR] [--planner file|claude] [--segments F] [--sync] [--json]   spec -> jobs, replan
  estimate [--batch DIR] [--json]                       machine / wall time, storage, API cost vs budget
  run [--batch DIR] [--pilot N] [--confirm-pilot] [--resume] [--retry-failed] [--jobs a,b]
      [--concurrency asr=1,cpu-render=2] [--json-events]   run the stage DAGs (resumable; refuses over budget)
  status [--batch DIR] [--json] [--events N]            terminal table
  review [--batch DIR] [--apply decisions.json|JSON] [--confirm-kinds a,b] [--accept-policy] [--jobs a,b]
         [--approve-green] [--json]
                                                        HTML grid + decisions sheet / ingest (+ bulk answers)
  job ID [--batch DIR] [--json] [--no-words]            one job: transcript + cleanup edits, captions, QC, exports
  package [--batch DIR] [--per-day N] [--start YYYY-MM-DD] [--times 12:00,19:00] [--json]   publish folders
  verify-manifest MANIFEST                              recompute a package's confirmation code (JSON)
  clean [--batch DIR] [--dry-run]                       delete regenerable intermediates of finished jobs
  du [--batch DIR]                                      disk use of the batch folder
  bench [--batch DIR]                                   the benchmark table used by estimate
  recipes [--json]                                      registered recipes (--json: labels, inputs, row keys)
v0.2 (desk; all with --json):
  plan-segments --source F [--transcript T] [--client C] [--count N] [--min S --max S] [--platforms a,b]
      [--provider auto|claude|openai|ollama|claude-code|...|none] [--out DIR]      transcript -> candidate segments -> segments.draft.yaml
  client init|show|update|list --client C [--set JSON]  client.yaml layered over the persona (effective config)
  job show ID | job edit --job J --op caption|trim|cut|notes|hook|cover|copy|undo ... | job rerun --job J [--json-events]
  deliver [--client C] [--zip] [--cleanup-days N] [--out DIR]   client delivery package + manifest hash
  cleanup-sources [--batch B | --client C | --all] [--confirm-delete CODE]   list (dry run + code) / delete exactly
                                                                that list; sources outside the batch folder: report only
  metrics --batch B | --client C | --all [--csv]        metrics JSON / weekly CSV
  timing --job J --event start|stop|add --what review [--seconds S]   review timing -> batch store
--json: one JSON document on stdout (paths absolute); run --json-events: one JSON event per line on stdout
(the human log goes to stderr). See references/BATCH.md section 7.
--batch defaults to the current folder when it holds batch.db.
Exit codes (run): 0 ok, 1 some jobs failed, 2 refused over budget, 3 paused (circuit breaker), 4 pilot waits.
```

## `vstudio.cleanup`

Shared speech cleanup: pauses, fillers, repeats, restarts.

```text
usage: python -m vstudio.cleanup [-h] {analyze,review,apply,verify} ...

Speech cleanup, one shared tool: 气口 (pauses / breaths), 口头禅 fillers, repeats, stammers,

positional arguments:
  {analyze,review,apply,verify}
    analyze             detect edits -> cleanup.json + cleanup_review.md
    review              print the review sheet of an EDL
    apply               cut the source with the decisions -> versioned output
    verify              re-ASR the output and flag lost content words (exit 1)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

## `vstudio.export`

One clean master into a file, cover and post stub per platform.

```text
usage: python -m vstudio.export [-h] [--platforms PLATFORMS] [--out OUT] [--cues CUES]
                                [--cover COVER] [--no-captions] [--title TITLE] [--post POST]
                                [--lang LANG] [--bilingual] [--account ACCOUNT]
                                [--mode {face,center,pad-blur,letterbox}]
                                [--fallback {center,pad-blur,letterbox}] [--start START]
                                [--dur DUR] [--encoder ENCODER] [--preset PRESET]
                                master

Multi-platform export: one clean master -> a file + cover + post stub per platform, plus a
manifest.

positional arguments:
  master                clean (caption-free) master video

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --platforms PLATFORMS
                        comma list of name[:orientation], e.g. xiaohongshu:vertical,douyin,youtube
                        (default persona platforms.default). Known: xiaohongshu:vertical,
                        xiaohongshu:full, xiaohongshu:horizontal, douyin:vertical,
                        douyin:horizontal, tiktok:vertical, youtube:horizontal, youtube-
                        shorts:vertical, bilibili:horizontal, bilibili:vertical, wechat-
                        channels:vertical, wechat-channels:horizontal, x:horizontal, x:square,
                        x:vertical, instagram:reels, instagram:feed, facebook:reels,
                        facebook:feed, facebook:horizontal, linkedin:horizontal, linkedin:square,
                        linkedin:feed, threads:vertical, threads:horizontal, reddit:horizontal,
                        reddit:square, reddit:vertical, pinterest:vertical, pinterest:feed,
                        pinterest:square, snapchat:vertical, kuaishou:vertical,
                        kuaishou:horizontal, weibo:horizontal, weibo:vertical, zhihu:horizontal,
                        zhihu:vertical, dailymotion:horizontal, dailymotion:vertical,
                        kwai:vertical
  --out OUT
  --cues CUES           cues.json (subs.Cue dicts) or .srt to burn per platform
  --cover COVER         cover image(s): a path (closest aspect wins; another aspect is fitted on a
                        blurred pad) or platform[:orientation]=path for one target, e.g. --cover
                        xiaohongshu=c34.png
  --no-captions         do not burn --cues (the master already carries its captions)
  --title TITLE         post title (checked against each platform's limit)
  --post POST           post.json {title, hook, body, chapters, links, tags} -> <target>.post.md
  --lang LANG           post copy language (en | zh); default: the content language detected from
                        the cues (English content -> English copy on X / Instagram / TikTok /
                        YouTube)
  --bilingual           post copy in English + Chinese (post.json en + zh blocks)
  --account ACCOUNT     account tier for limits, e.g. premium (X: longer videos/posts)
  --mode {face,center,pad-blur,letterbox}
                        reframe mode when the aspect changes
  --fallback {center,pad-blur,letterbox}
  --start START
  --dur DUR
  --encoder ENCODER     H.264 encoder (default $VSTUDIO_H264_ENCODER / persona export.h264_encoder
                        / libx264): libx264 | videotoolbox | h264_videotoolbox | h264_mf
  --preset PRESET
```

## `vstudio.reframe`

Face-tracked reframe between aspect ratios.

```text
usage: python -m vstudio.reframe [-h] [--size SIZE] [--platform PLATFORM]
                                 [--mode {face,center,pad-blur,letterbox}]
                                 [--fallback {center,pad-blur,letterbox}] [--start START]
                                 [--dur DUR] [--zoom ZOOM] [--every EVERY]
                                 src dst

Reframe a video to another canvas: face-tracked virtual camera, centre crop, blurred-fill or
letterbox.

positional arguments:
  src
  dst

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --size SIZE           WxH (default from --platform)
  --platform PLATFORM   e.g. douyin or xiaohongshu:vertical (size + safe box)
  --mode {face,center,pad-blur,letterbox}
  --fallback {center,pad-blur,letterbox}
  --start START
  --dur DUR
  --zoom ZOOM
  --every EVERY         detect every N frames
```

## `vstudio.effects`

List and inspect the effect registry.

```text
usage: python -m vstudio.effects [-h] [--write-md] [--check] [--show ID] [--list]
                                 [--engine {pil-frame,ffmpeg,hyperframes,html,audio}]
                                 [--category {camera,layout,cards,text,highlight,freeze,transitions,looks,audio,progress,covers}]

Effect registry: every visual / audio effect in video-studio as one declarative catalogue.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --write-md            regenerate the block in references/EFFECTS.md
  --check               verify every entry point
  --show ID
  --list
  --engine {pil-frame,ffmpeg,hyperframes,html,audio}
  --category {camera,layout,cards,text,highlight,freeze,transitions,looks,audio,progress,covers}
```

## `vstudio.llm`

AI providers on this machine: list, route, auth, test.

```text
usage: python -m vstudio.llm [-h] {providers,route,auth,test} ...

LLM / ASR / TTS providers on this machine

positional arguments:
  {providers,route,auth,test}
    providers           list LLM, ASR and TTS providers and whether they work here
    route               show which provider each task would use
    auth                auth status | login | logout (see vstudio.llm_auth)
    test                one tiny JSON round-trip

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```
